newsitem.title: GREECE: Michaniki to go ahead with rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Michaniki to go ahead with rights issue.

text.p: Construction firm Michaniki got shareholder approval for a 11.2 billion drachma rights issue at Thursday's extraordinary meeting.

The company will issue a total of 3,398,630 new common registered shares and an equal number of preferred registered shares. The terms will be two new common and two new preferred shares for every ten outstanding.
The issue price has been set at 1,900 and 1,400 drachmas for common and preferred stock, respectively.
The last cum-rights day is Wednesday April 17. Rights may be exercised between May 13 and June 13.
Michaniki will also proceed with a bonus issue of two common or preferred shares for every 10 outstanding.
All shares arising from the rights issue are entitled to the scrip issue as well.
Bonus shares will be distributed July 1, 1997.
Michaniki's common and preferred shares closed at 2,780 and 2,100 on Wednesday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
